name: Radon Number / Log Shattering (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal S_n$, Radon number is $n$, while log shattering is $\log_2(n+1)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, log shattering is $n$, while Radon number is $\lfloor\log_2(2n+2)\rfloor$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Radon Number and Log Shattering of Full Cube and Singletons.
